description: Implementation of the WindowManager class for HTTP/2 window size management, including functions for updating window limits, buffering, flushing, and notifying listeners.

classes.name: WindowManager
classes.description: Manages flow control window size, buffering, and listener notifications for HTTP/2 streams.

methods.name: DefaultShouldWindowUpdateFn
methods.description: Default function to determine if a window update should be sent based on current limits and delta.

methods.name: OnWindowSizeLimitChange
methods.description: Adjusts the window size limit and updates internal state accordingly.

methods.name: SetWindowSizeLimit
methods.description: Sets a new window size limit and potentially notifies the listener.

methods.name: MarkDataBuffered
methods.description: Marks bytes as buffered, updates window size, and may notify listener if window is full.

methods.name: MarkDataFlushed
methods.description: Marks bytes as flushed, updates buffered data, and may notify listener.

methods.name: MaybeNotifyListener
methods.description: Checks if a window update is needed and notifies the listener if so.
